annotations.text:
Headline is savings plus money put into investments — not net worth, because market value is out of scope by design.
The month-end card is the motivator: the far-off target divided by the months left gives a figure for THIS month, and the bar fills as the gap closes.
Derived, never typed in.

The + button floats over every tab. Tap it and this sheet slides up.
Two numbers, because the monthly contribution is the difference between successive invested totals — the app works it out and shows it back.

No account, no backend, no analytics. Data is written to IndexedDB on the device.
Two CSV exports feed a Google Sheet by hand each month — entries on one tab, summary on the other.
A JSON backup is the route to a new phone. Nothing syncs on its own.
